contract.no_sentence_reownership_rule: The selector may choose among already-owned notice normal forms and emitted notices, but it may not rewrite the rendered sentence or pointer order they already own.
contract.normal_form_choice_rule: A selection may choose only a canonical notice normal form whose allowed token set matches the imported basis object and whose rendered sentence agrees with the emitted notice sentence.
contract.selector_totality_rule: For every imported emitted public-request notice, the selector must map its basis-token combination to exactly one maintained canonical notice normal form.

note: Derived selector ledger for the worked note's source-only public-request notices. It chooses which maintained canonical notice normal form applies to each emitted within-release or successor-facing notice given the imported status/carryforward basis tokens.

public_request_notice_selections.rendered_sentence: For this source-only release, the worked note's paper-level public request promise is complete and supporting artifacts remain available on request.
public_request_notice_selections.why: The within-release basis token is complete, so the selector chooses the complete-status canonical source-only notice family rather than a different within-release wrapper.

public_request_notice_selections.rendered_sentence: Across the canned successor release, that complete paper-level public request status carries forward unchanged.
public_request_notice_selections.why: The successor-facing basis tokens are complete plus preserved-complete, so the selector chooses the preserved-complete carryforward notice family rather than a reopen or advance wrapper.
